notes.title: 01.22 2024 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h2][Fixed Features] [/h2]

Fixed errors in the long-range shooting of the bishop that were causing inaccuracies in hitting the target

notes.title: 01.21 2024 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h2][Fixed Features][/h2]

Sometimes, we have modified the section that becomes frame drop.

I'm sorry for affecting your play.

notes.title: 01.15 2024 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b][h2][Additional Features][/h2][/b]

1. Added the ability to change the monitor resolution settings in the Settings window.

[b][h2][Fixed Features][/h2][/b]

1. Fixed an error that caused the animation of the existing monster to get weird if you did something else just before you changed your body with a hack.
2. Fixed an error that the UI size gets smaller and smaller when repeatedly entering the stage selection window.
3. Fixed an error that sometimes passed through the wall when attached to some interaction objects and using the dash.
4. Modified the feature that player would not initialize hacking progress if the target was not a monster.

notes.title: 01.12 2024 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[Additional Features]

1. Even if you don't die, you can always restart at Checkpoint in the game!
-> Press ESC to restart at the checkpoint at any time.

2. You can start by selecting age Stage.
-> Even if the user turns it off and turns it on, the game can continue from the desired stage.

[Fixed function]

1. Fixed an error that didn't progress even if you caught all the monsters in Stage 2.
